release.content: pubtest 0.2.0 was released on 2026-11-17 from commit 502f35cf106a6579342fc5c4b6154685af8628cc with these changes.

rows: wheel.yml attaches the wheel to each release, as pubhost's does
A suite with a ctx fixture of its own (a dict, as suites had under pubkit's plugin) keeps every pubtest step: the steps use pubtest_ctx, which is the suite's ctx only when it is pubtest's

Hypothesis's examples per property come from PUBRULES_FUZZ_RUNS, which pubrules' CI sets, in place of PUBKIT_FUZZ_RUNS, and run under a profile named pubrules; pubtest no longer refuses to load beside pubkit's old pytest plugin, which pubkit 0.42.0 dropped

release.scope: the published release v0.2.0 of pubtest
